2608.20975.title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models
2608.20975.paper_summary: Effective social interaction requires agents to translate mental state inferences into coordinated behavioral signals across verbal and nonverbal channels simultaneously. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate theory of mind (ToM) reasoning and embodied behavior in isolation, leaving unmeasured the gap between social inference and social action. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orchestration of Social Action, Inference, and Communication), a controlled benchmark in which two embodied agents interact across cooperative and competitive scenarios requiring integration of verbal statements, spatial trajectories, gaze direction, and facial expression under systematically varied ToM constraints. Evaluating 13 models, including 11 VLMs, across 200 trials per model, we find that VLMs fail to produce behaviors consistent with the expected outcomes under ToM-order constraints, and that imposing explicit ToM-order constraints produces no reliable behavioral change aligned with the specified reasoning level. Signal-level analysis reveals two sequential bottlenecks: most models cannot produce directionally coherent nonverbal signals, and even when signals are present, VLM agents fail to interpret others behaviors and react to them. PCM-LLM, included as a structured architectural reference point with an explicit ToM module, succeeds across all conditions, suggesting that explicit belief-action coupling is a sufficient ingredient for this class of tasks.
2608.20975.paper_summary_zh: 有效的社會互動要求代理人將心理狀態推斷轉化為在口頭和非口頭通道上同時協調的行為信號。<lb/>然而，現有的基準評估心智理論（ToM）推理和具身行為是孤立進行的，未能測量社會推斷與社會行動之間的差距。<lb/>我們引入了MOSAIC（社會行動、推斷和溝通的多模態協調），這是一個受控基準，兩個具身代理人在合作和競爭場景中互動，這些場景要求在系統變化的ToM約束下整合口頭陳述、空間軌跡、注視方向和面部表情。<lb/>在對13個模型進行評估，包括11個VLM，在每個模型的200次試驗中，我們發現VLM未能產生與ToM順序約束下預期結果一致的行為，並且施加明確的ToM順序約束並未產生與指定推理水平一致的可靠行為變化。<lb/>信號級分析揭示了兩個連續的瓶頸：大多數模型無法產生方向一致的非語言信號，即使信號存在，VLM代理人也無法解釋他人的行為並對其作出反應。<lb/>PCM-LLM作為一個具有明確ToM模塊的結構性架構參考點，在所有條件下都取得成功，這表明明確的信念-行動耦合是這類任務的充分條件。
